text: The accepted namespace is tb_l10n. Imports use tb_l10n.l10n_merge, tb_l10n.missing_ftl and tb_l10n.tb_migration_test. 1011/1015 move missing_ftl from a package __init__.py into missing_ftl.py and retain lower_snake_case for the other Python modules. Follow that package/module family rather than applying JavaScript dash or camel conventions to Python paths. Update Python tooling classification and build-task imports with such moves.
title: Use Python package and module names from the localization family
